# Manual Bank Payment

Creates and observes a manual bank-transfer instruction. The recipient acts as the confirming guarantor; the payer may report a transfer, but reporting does not establish that money arrived. Manual Payment Setup selects the manual-bank-transfer method and recipient confirmation. The amount binding defaults to `/product/totalMinor` and instruction placement to `/payment`.

The inherited lifecycle prevents conflicting instruction identities and routes named request actions into the instruction. Recipient confirmations and recorded outcomes, rather than creation or a request event, determine accepted, completed, reversed and pending financial state.

Configuration references: `bindings.amount` defaults to `/product/totalMinor`; `bindings.instruction` defaults to `/payment`.
